rollback_evidence: Measured directly on devices: FortiGate-60F FortiOS 7.6.8 build3744 (2026-11-14, task 168, CLI; ref/mereni-60f-168.md) and FortiGate-80F active-passive HA FortiOS 8.0.2 build0251 (2026-11-14, task 177). CLI create, update, comment unset/empty-string equivalence, referenced-delete refusal (-23), delete/recreate with a new uuid, append order, and predefined HTTPS edit discarded by abort were measured on both builds. Default protocol is TCP/UDP/UDP-Lite/SCTP on both; visibility is absent on both; proxy disable is present only on 8.0.2, app-service-type disable only on 7.6.8. On 8.0.2, direct REST GET/POST/PUT/DELETE at /api/v2/cmdb/firewall.service/custom with mkey name succeeded using only fwgrp read-write and a single source /32 trusthost; PUT comment empty cleared a verified nonempty comment. All temporary services, group, API user and access profile were removed. Service/group outputs and HA checksum returned exactly to baseline; full configuration matched after normalization of the revision header and per-read encrypted private-key PEM envelopes, whose variability was independently observed without configuration writes. End-to-end NetOps Admin measurement (2026-11-14, task 180; evidence-1.0.9/109-17/e2e-admin-180), with a local test image of main 30948f7 whose only change set this profile to provisional false and measured true: on FortiGate-60F FortiOS 7.6.8 build3744 (cli-script safeguard, write account with fwgrp read-write) and on the FortiGate-80F active-passive HA pair FortiOS 8.0.2 build0251 (webhook safeguard, super_admin write account), admin enroll --probe ended reverted; admin_preview was ready and admin_apply confirmed for create, update of tcp-portrange and comment, comment unset and delete; admin undo confirmed for the unset, the update, the delete (the service was recreated with a new uuid; on 8.0.2 through the REST POST inverse path) and the create. With the check account lost after change_applied the result was reverted for an update (cli-script / webhook PUT) and for a create (cli-script / webhook DELETE): the changed or created service was on the device during the window and was back in the before state after trigger-datetime. Admin refused before any write the delete and a port-range change of a service referenced by a service group, and update and delete of the protected HTTPS. Admin reads the abbreviated show output, so proxy disable (8.0.2) and app-service-type disable (7.6.8) did not appear as configuration outside the profile. After cleanup no netops-sg object stayed, the service list, groups, HTTPS, HA checksum and administrator table equalled the state before, the full configuration matched after normalization of the revision header and of values re-encrypted on every read, the HA pair was in sync, and the Admin audit had every request paired with its response. Not measured: the safeguard firing a POST inverse (undo of a delete reverted by the safeguard), SIGKILL with admin recover and loss of the whole management path for this table; comment and port-range length limits.
